newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal 1996 selloffs to earn 460 bln esc - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal 1996 selloffs to earn 460 bln esc - paper.

text.p: Under-Secretary for Finance Fernando Teixeira dos Santos, in an interview with a Lisbon paper, said Portugal could earn 460 billion escudos from privatisations this year and at least 410 billion next year.

Asked how much the state would garner from privatisations this year, he told the Diario de Noticias: "Factoring in the sale of (tobacco company) Tabaqueira this year, I believe we can reach 460 billion escudos, 80 billion more than expected."
Teixeira dos Santos, directly responsible for the Socialist government's privatisation programme, was asked how much the state would earn next year and replied:
"Our forecast for next year, in terms of revenues for the Public Debt Regularisation Fund, is about 410 billion escudos. But not all the privatisation revenues will go to that fund."
